# MCP Tools

## Tools

- [lattice.search](lattice-search/) — Search the canonical Roblox workspace and return compact stable rbx:// references and evidence IDs.
- [lattice.workspace.status](lattice-workspace-status/) — Return the active canonical workspace identity, revision, and indexed source count.
- [lattice.provider.list](lattice-provider-list/) — List configured providers with compact health and connection state; does not connect them.
- [lattice.tool.search](lattice-tool-search/) — Search the unified tool catalog and return compact references without loading full schemas.
- [lattice.tool.inspect](lattice-tool-inspect/) — Inspect one exact lattice:// provider tool reference and load its schema and safety metadata.
- [lattice.capabilities](lattice-capabilities/) — Discover the semantic Lattice operations enabled by this server.
